comparisons.name: side-tabs-light
comparisons.description: Tabs on the left and on the right, first tab selected, Aqua: the accent gradient runs across the strip, from its outer edge to the edge that faces the content. No screenshot shows side tabs.

pixels.note: left strip, a quarter of the way in from its outer (left) edge: --mac-accent-bezel-upper, the gradient's 25% stop (spec: tab-view, Selected fill gradient, measured on top tabs; orientation inferred)
left strip, three quarters in: --mac-accent-bezel-lower, the 75% stop
right strip, a quarter of the way in from its outer (right) edge: --mac-accent-bezel-upper
right strip, three quarters in: --mac-accent-bezel-lower
left strip, unselected tab: fill (spec: Unselected fill, measured)

left strip, unselected tab, near its outer edge: the same fill as near its inner edge, because the unselected fill (--mac-bezel-fill) is one flat colour and has no shading to turn (spec: Unselected fill, measured on top tabs)
left strip, unselected tab, near its inner edge
right strip, unselected tab, near its outer edge
right strip, unselected tab, near its inner edge

comparisons.name: side-tabs-dark
comparisons.description: Tabs on the left and on the right, first tab selected, Dark Aqua: gradient and top highlight are turned with the strip.

pixels.note: left strip, a quarter in from its outer edge: --mac-accent-bezel-upper (measured on top tabs; orientation inferred)
left strip, three quarters in: --mac-accent-bezel-lower
right strip, a quarter in from its outer edge: --mac-accent-bezel-upper
right strip, three quarters in: --mac-accent-bezel-lower
left strip, the half-point highlight on its outer edge (spec: Selected top edge highlight #5c96f0, measured on top tabs)
right strip, the half-point highlight on its outer edge

left strip, unselected tab, near its outer edge: the same fill as near its inner edge, because the unselected fill (--mac-bezel-fill over the window background) is one flat colour and has no shading to turn (spec: Unselected fill, measured on top tabs)
left strip, unselected tab, near its inner edge
right strip, unselected tab, near its outer edge
right strip, unselected tab, near its inner edge

comparisons.name: side-tabs-rtl-light
comparisons.description: The side tabs of side-tabs-light inside dir=rtl, Aqua. Left and right are physical sides: each strip stays on its side, on the edge of the content box painted for it, with the first tab at the top. No screenshot shows side tabs or a right-to-left window.

pixels.note: left strip, first tab (top), selected, a quarter of the way in from its outer edge: --mac-accent-bezel-upper, as in side-tabs-light (orientation and right-to-left placement inferred)
right strip, first tab (top), selected, a quarter of the way in from its outer edge: --mac-accent-bezel-upper
left strip, second tab (bottom), unselected: fill (spec: Unselected fill, measured on top tabs)
right strip, second tab (bottom), unselected: fill

comparisons.name: pane-corner-light
comparisons.description: Top-left corner of the tab view's content box, from the Sound pane, Aqua. Threshold 0.02, because the box's border is too faint for a higher one to count any pixel. This is the comparison that follows --mac-radius-group in a tab view.

comparisons.name: pane-corner-dark
comparisons.description: Top-left corner of the tab view's content box, from the Sound pane, Dark Aqua. Threshold as for pane-corner-light.
